evidence: Two packages (budou and tests), with no separate service boundaries or network communication
Clear module separation in budou/ directory with focused responsibilities (segmenter, chunk, parser, cache)
Segmenter classes (MecabSegmenter, NLAPISegmenter, TinysegmenterSegmenter) inherit from a common abstract base (Segmenter), indicating polymorphic but cohesive design
Parser classes depend on multiple Segmenter implementations and Chunk utilities, showing interdependent but encapsulated modules
No remote procedure calls, message queues, or external service dependencies visible
Single codebase deployed as one unit (setup.py, setup.cfg, no separate deployments)
Directory structure (budou/, tests/, docs/) follows typical modular monolith layout
risks: Tight coupling between Parser and multiple Segmenter implementations may reduce testability and extensibility
Use of abstract base classes is good, but dynamic parser instantiation via get_parser() suggests some flexibility, though still within one process
